verdict.rationale: Kick documents genuine multi-entity workspace management—each entity keeps its own books/reports, and shared expenses can be split across entities by amount or percentage (kick-docs-5, kick-docs-19, kick-docs-6). However, there is no evidence of true consolidated financials (e.g., a combined P&L/Balance Sheet rolling up multiple entities into one statement) — the docs explicitly note each entity has separate books/reports rather than a unified consolidated view. Missing for 10: documented consolidation reports/statements across entities, intercompany elimination handling, and any UI/report showing combined financials rather than per-entity splitting.
